about: GUARD-WIDEN name law: generic code never names a declared application's vocabulary. Read by packages/dev-tooling/src/module-press-law.ts (PRESS010-PRESS015). Every packages/*/src and apps/*/src must be in scope or excluded (PRESS010 otherwise). A Critical pathspec (AGENTS.md).

excluded.reason: The first-party declarations themselves (audit class A1); the vocabulary lives here by design. PRESS003-005 police its contents.
Repository tooling and architecture guards, never shipped; a guard has to name what it checks.

platformOwned.name: legal_entity
platformOwned.reason: ADR-0015 makes the legal entity (company) the platform's business scoping dimension; every generic layer scopes by it, so it is platform vocabulary, not an application's.

externalNames.name: location_type
externalNames.reason: The geocoding provider's own response key (geometry.location_type), not the first-party Location field.
